purpose: Make AI-assisted delivery traceable, bounded and reviewable; this policy does not grant production access or replace human approval.

rules: A sub-agent may write only within its declared writeScope.
A sub-agent may not create a second sub-agent unless its parent task explicitly permits it.
A sub-agent must stop and return control when it needs credentials, a production action, an expanded write scope, or private user data.
A manager or assigned owner approves deployment, publishing, migration repair and irreversible actions.
